raw_text: WazirX $230 Million Hack Attributed to North Korean Lazarus Group by Multiple Cybersecurity Firms. Indian cryptocurrency exchange WazirX lost approximately $230 million in digital assets to hackers identified by Mandiant, Elliptic, and Chainalysis as North Korea's Lazarus Group. The sophisticated attack combined social engineering through fake LinkedIn job offers with technical exploitation of exchange infrastructure. DPRK-linked accounts attempted to deflect blame by promoting insider fraud theories on social media.
